models.notes: Azure OpenAI uses subscription-level quota pools (not per-deployment) since May 2026. Global Standard shares one pool across all Azure regions. Data Zone Standard splits into US and EU pools. Tiers auto-upgrade (Free -> Tier 1 -> Tier 6) based on usage and account relationship. Values shown are Tier 1 defaults.

global-standard.notes: Single pool shared across all Azure regions. Tier 1 default.

data-zone-standard.notes: One pool per data zone (US zone, EU zone). Tier 1 default.
